credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/flytrap.py. Reference photo venus_flytrap/teen_alt2.jpg by Austin Pursley (iNaturalist: autrpy) (CC0 1.0), https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/42729834: used as a drawing reference, not traced. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Gesture: a lunge then a snap (wind-up held 16 ticks, a 4-tick strike, SNAP held, recoil). Only the head and the neck above its base move; the claws, body and the raised fist stay pixel-identical. Learned: anticipation is what sells the strike; without the wind-up the snap reads as a flicker. Sport: 'Akai Ryu'.
